units.source_text: 这是朝仓和我按事先谈好的一套撒了个谎。

en.t: This was a lie that Asakura and I told according to a plan we had agreed on beforehand.

units.source_text: 半月之内，我两次从东京来岐阜探望道子，未免不够稳重吧。

en.t: Within half a month, coming twice from Tokyo to Gifu to visit Michiko would surely seem rather imprudent.

units.source_text: 因此，为了敷衍养父母，我寄给道子的信这样写道：

en.t: So, in order to satisfy my foster parents, I wrote the letter I sent to Michiko like this:

units.source_text: 我要到名古屋作毕业旅行，顺道去探望你。

en.t: I am going to Nagoya for my graduation trip, and I will stop by to see you on the way.

units.source_text: 这样，我们头天晚上不是住在静冈的旅馆，而是坐在火车上。

en.t: In this way, the night before, we were not staying at an inn in Shizuoka but sitting on the train.

units.source_text: 我服了安眠药。

en.t: I took a sleeping pill.

units.source_text: 本想借助安眠药稍睡一觉，第二天早晨脸色会润泽些。

en.t: I meant to use the sleeping pill to get a little sleep, so my complexion would look fresher the next morning.

units.source_text: 可是，第二天我和道子之间的遐思浮想，竟把我带到无边的远方。

en.t: But the next day, the reveries drifting between Michiko and me carried me away to a boundless distance.

units.source_text: 我做过好几回同样的梦，每回都觉着新鲜。

en.t: I had had the same dream several times, yet each time it felt new.

units.source_text: 真正在毕业旅行之后乘火车回家的女学生，

en.t: The schoolgirls who were truly returning home by train after their graduation trip

units.source_text: 连车厢的通道都给铺满了报纸，彼此背靠背地坐在上面。

en.t: had even spread newspapers over the aisle of the carriage and sat on them back to back.

units.source_text: 有的人把脸靠在邻近的少女肩上。

en.t: Some rested their faces on the shoulders of the girls beside them.

units.source_text: 有的人将额头埋在双膝间的行李上。

en.t: Others buried their foreheads in the luggage between their knees.

units.source_text: 一张张睡脸，露出了旅途的倦态，活像一朵朵绽开的小白花。

en.t: Each sleeping face showed the weariness of travel, just like a small white flower in bloom.

units.source_text: 我一个人醒来了。

en.t: I alone woke up.

units.source_text: 车厢里坐满了少女，我们仿佛闯进了女校包租的客车。

en.t: The carriage was filled with girls, as if we had wandered into a car chartered by a girls' school.

units.source_text: 少女们一入睡，脸上便呈现雪白色，显得更不解风情。

en.t: Once the girls fell asleep, their faces turned snow white, making them look all the more innocent of romance.

units.source_text: 道子比这些少女年轻，可她的脸上没有这种稚气。

en.t: Michiko was younger than these girls, but her face did not have that childishness.

units.source_text: 我只觉得她的睡脸比车厢里的任何一张睡脸都标致得多。

en.t: I only felt that her sleeping face was far prettier than any sleeping face in the carriage.

units.source_text: 这些乘客都是和歌山和名古屋的女学生。

en.t: These passengers were all schoolgirls from Wakayama and Nagoya.

units.source_text: 从总体来说，名古屋的少女头发丰盛。

en.t: On the whole, the girls from Nagoya had abundant hair.

units.source_text: 朝仓夸奖了其中一个少女。

en.t: Asakura praised one of the girls.

units.source_text: 我望了望她，只见她把半边脸贴在酣睡中的另一个少女圆匀的脊背上，

en.t: I looked at her and saw that she had pressed one side of her face against the smooth round back of another girl sleeping soundly,

units.source_text: 像搂住车窗似的。

en.t: as though she were embracing the train window.

units.source_text: 这张睡脸，眉毛、睫毛和嘴唇线条鲜明，

en.t: In that sleeping face, the lines of the eyebrows, eyelashes, and lips were sharply defined,

units.source_text: 五官端正，艳丽极了。

en.t: the features were well formed, and it was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 而且乍看天真得令人怜爱。

en.t: And at first glance it seemed so innocent as to be endearing.

units.source_text: 我急忙紧紧闭上眼睛，

en.t: I hurriedly shut my eyes tight,

units.source_text: 在脑海里清楚地想象着道子的容颜，心里很是焦灼。

en.t: clearly picturing Michiko's face in my mind, and I felt terribly anxious.

units.source_text: 假使不用眼睛直接捕捉道子，

en.t: If I did not grasp Michiko directly with my own eyes,

units.source_text: 我企盼的清晰的道子，总是不会让我看见的。

en.t: the vivid Michiko I longed for would never let herself be seen by me.
